field_semantics.party[].species: IDENTITY — the only battle-facing field; the build input (PM ruling D4, 2026-11-23)
field_semantics.party[].level: IDENTITY-HISTORY ONLY — the source game's recorded level for that tier; provenance, NEVER a build value
field_semantics.party[].iv: IDENTITY-HISTORY ONLY — the source game's recorded IV value (0-255 scale); provenance, NEVER a build value
field_semantics.build_rule: Tier tables supply species/identity only. Every rematch battle party is built at battle time by the difficulty layer (PUWTeamBuilder.build_trainer_team / build_mon): exactly 6 Pokemon, IV 31 in every stat, EV spread = the species' best sourced set under the 510 cap, best nature/ability/moveset (egg moves included where the sourced set carries them), level scaled to the player, sets re-sourced on evolution with EV redistribution only where the evolved build requires it. Applies identically to Pokemon and Moemon parties — Moemon mirror PKDX stats/moves/evolutions, so the same builder and the same sourced sets produce Moemon parties at the identical standard; no separate, weaker path.

prize_money.formula: prize_base = 4 * (level of last party member) * class_prize_value * (2 if double_battle else 1)
prize_money.source: src/battle_main.c (gTrainerMoneyTable) + src/battle_script_commands.c (Cmd_getmoneyreward: moneyReward = 4 * lastMonLevel * moneyMultiplier * (double ? 2 : 1) * class value; moneyMultiplier is the Amulet Coin / Luck Incense seam the prep applies on top, so it is NOT folded into prize_base)

provenance: Transcribed from held pret/pokefirered source (read under Riley's standing mechanics authorization; data extraction only, no downloaded code built or run). Tier rows: src/vs_seeker.c sRematches[] (SKIP preserved as null). Parties: src/data/trainer_parties.h. Trainer class / double-battle flag: src/data/trainers.h gTrainers[]. prize_base derived per tier with the source formula in prize_money (src/battle_main.c gTrainerMoneyTable + src/battle_script_commands.c Cmd_getmoneyreward); the class prize value used is recorded in TABLES_REPORT.md reconciliation and reproducible from prize_money.class_prize_values. iv is the source .iv value verbatim (0-255 scale; per-stat IV = iv*31/255 in the source engine). Party fields with no fixture counterpart (moves, held_item) are carried on the party entries, never dropped.
